name: Hypercare & Stabilization (SDLC Phase 12)
description: Post-launch support and stabilization — aka Post-Launch Support, Warranty Period, Hot Stage.
owner: SDLC Templates — NoteShare Pro Reference Library

capabilities.name: Hypercare & Stabilization
capabilities.description: Stabilizes the product after launch through active monitoring, rapid issue resolution, and structured retrospective learning.

checklists.statement: Issues logged during hypercare are triaged and assigned an owner within the agreed response window.
checklists.prompt: Are known issues from the hypercare period being triaged and assigned within the agreed response window?

reviewGates.statement: The Hypercare & Stabilization's deliverables have been reviewed and accepted as sufficient to proceed to Growth & Optimization.
reviewGates.prompt: Do the operational KPIs and post-mortem show the product has stabilized sufficiently to justify moving into Growth & Optimization?
